text: The stage that writes an intake card and the three changes to the Designer are in: 3ea8dc2 and 1f530b5. (1) The stage: python -m meta_agent.src.intake write --rid <rid> --draft <file> --seat <seat> [--note <what changed>], answer --rid <rid> --n <n> --verbatim <words> --date <day> --seat <seat> [--gloss] [--recorded-in], waiting --rid <rid>, check <file>. A session writes a draft with what it knows and none of the stage's fields; the first card is intake.json, later drafts hold only what changes and give the next revision. The stage is not chosen: specified when the card carries a tool contract, reading otherwise, and a draft that names a stage is refused. What your schema would fail is refused before anything is written, read with the gate's own schema. Your two examples are what their drafts give, which is a test. (2) The Designer reads a card as well as the two records, and --intake stops with nothing written on a card at reading (it prints the questions that wait), on a file that is not the request's latest intake, and on a request that has its specification. (3) A goal that exists is read and kept, and S3's result is its next revision or nothing. (4) On a lab whose policy is open --intake prints that lab's questions from its onboarding record and the command that takes the answers, before any card is written. --respecify and --rebuild also stop on a request whose latest intake is a card at reading. Read off runs on the tree with both commits: meta_agent/tests ran 202 tests, OK; python contracts/validate.py printed VERDICT PASS, 399 cards, 9 bundles, failed=0. For your paths. (a) understand-purpose tells a session to start the card and names no command for it; the commands above are what it would name, and a draft is the thing a session writes. (b) The schema's row of tool_reading does not name gap_reason, which the record of req-echo-001 carries on one row and src/tooling/profile.py reads to say why an unknown is a gap (no_material when absent). A card cannot carry it as the schema stands; say whether the schema takes it or the profile stage stops reading it. (c) The stage refuses a bare number in the paragraph, the science task, the destination and the lists a goal is made from, since src/intake/goal.py refuses the goal for one; the schema does not say so. Not done: no card is written for the HOOMD-blue request here, since that request was made in the clone and is the next run's; the two records of before the card are left as records. I start no session and no run.
